_comment: Unit list prices used by cost-meter. USD. Each entry names its primary source and the date it was read. Refresh before a new region or instance type.

ec2_usd_per_hour._source: AWS Pricing API get-products AmazonEC2, regionCode eu-west-1, Linux, Shared, On Demand, 2026-10-04

aws._ebs_source: AWS Pricing API AmazonEC2 volumeApiName gp3, eu-west-1, 2026-10-04
aws._ipv4_source: AWS Pricing API AmazonVPC group VPCPublicIPv4Address, EU-PublicIPv4:InUseAddress, 2026-10-04
aws._cpu_credit_source: AWS Pricing API AmazonEC2 usagetype EU-CPUCredits:t4g, 2026-10-04

burstable_baseline_fraction._source: AWS docs, burstable performance instances, baseline utilization per vCPU for t4g.xlarge (40 %)

aws._fargate_source: https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonECS/current/eu-west-1/index.json ; 2026-10-04; ARM Linux OnDemand SKUs KXC9CEUQGJQPNZPY / MGJ5EB5GSHR8QZDF; task allocation includes Agent sidecar
aws._alb_source: https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AWSELB/current/eu-west-1/index.json ; 2026-10-04; regional Application OnDemand SKUs T29JAP5UEZ7HXAM7 / YE8QE7GMG9794PDX; base hourly line excludes variable LCU usage
aws._elasticache_source: https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonElastiCache/current/eu-west-1/index.json ; 2026-10-04; Redis OnDemand SKU Q8MBFSX7FCA3HNJW; excludes extended support

confluent._kafka_source: confluent billing price list --cloud aws --region eu-west-1 (Basic, Internet), 2026-10-04
confluent._flink_source: docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/flink/concepts/flink-billing.html, '$0.21/CFU-hour, calculated by the minute', 2026-10-04. 'Prices vary by cloud region': eu-west-1 multiplier is assumed to be 1.0; confirm before using another region.
confluent._bytes_per_gb_note: Decimal GB is assumed; confirm whether Confluent bills GB or GiB before using this estimate (difference about 7 %).

datadog._note: Datadog subscription charges are not estimated here; check the current plan or trial before relying on a zero-cost assumption.
